intended_object: One leaf of a certificate tree that is checked by computation. It is the `CompactCellTree` node `.absurd 521`, which closes one branch of the genus-5, row-06 case analysis by pointing to Farkas certificate number 521. This comes from the docstring and from how the surrounding certificate files are built.
explanation: This definition has no mathematical counterpart. It is proof-certificate data: one subtree of a computer-checked case split, used inside the Brill–Noether graphs low-genus proof. Its whole body, `.absurd 521`, tells the checker to use Farkas certificate 521 to show that this branch's accumulated affine constraints are infeasible. It is an internal device for a proof, not a mathematical concept, so it cannot be judged as faithful or not.
